findings.name: On a 390 px screen a long note title pushes the record counter and the record action buttons out of view in the header
findings.summary: At 390 px the title in the breadcrumb is cut with \"…\" but the record counter is clipped mid-value (shown as \"(2/1,80\") and the record's action buttons at the right end of that row (favourite / previous / next / \"…\" menu) are pushed completely outside the viewport, so they cannot be reached or scrolled to. The count and the actions stay unreachable at this width. (on /object/note/7a8282b9-36eb-4673-94da-737e357ac545)
findings.expected: The header row reflows at 390 px: the long title truncates with an ellipsis and the record counter and the record's action buttons stay visible and reachable, with no horizontal clipping.
findings.actual: At 390 px the title in the breadcrumb is cut with \"…\" but the record counter is clipped mid-value (shown as \"(2/1,80\") and the record's action buttons at the right end of that row (favourite / previous / next / \"…\" menu) are pushed completely outside the viewport, so they cannot be reached or scrolled to. The count and the actions stay unreachable at this width.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open https://5500-ixmruf4hfnd9dnfal6vzl.e2b.app/objects/notes.
Click the blue "+ New Note" button and type a long title, e.g. "agent7-LongTitle-AaBbCcDdEe" repeated until about 330 characters.
Click "Open" at the bottom of the side panel to open the note's record page (URL /object/note/7a8282b9-36eb-4673-94da-737e357ac545).
Set the browser viewport to 390 x 844 CSS pixels (mobile).
If the navigation panel covers the screen, click "Collapse navigation panel".
Look at the page header row: "Notes / agent7-LongTitle-AaBbCcDd…" followed by the note counter.

findings.name: Same note in two tabs: the Fields panel updates live but the body editor keeps the old text, and saving from the stale tab silently discards the other tab's text
findings.summary: The Fields panel is updated live by the other tab while the body editor keeps the stale text, so one screen shows two different values of the same field (Body = agent9-VERSION-A in the panel, \"a\" in the editor; later Body = agent9-VERSION-B-STALE in the panel, agent9-VERSION-A in the editor). Editing in the stale tab then saves the whole stale body with no warning and silently replaces the other tab's text. (on /object/note/14611a41-c44e-4294-9ac5-0acdaff3ffa8)
findings.expected: Both tabs show one consistent value for the body (either the editor follows the live update, or the editor keeps the old text and the Fields panel does too), and a save from a tab whose editor is stale should be flagged as a conflict instead of silently overwriting the other tab's text.
findings.actual: The Fields panel is updated live by the other tab while the body editor keeps the stale text, so one screen shows two different values of the same field (Body = agent9-VERSION-A in the panel, \"a\" in the editor; later Body = agent9-VERSION-B-STALE in the panel, agent9-VERSION-A in the editor). Editing in the stale tab then saves the whole stale body with no warning and silently replaces the other tab's text.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev, open /object/note/14611a41-c44e-4294-9ac5-0acdaff3ffa8 (note "agent9-note-UNSAVED") in tab A and in a second tab B, both on the Note tab.
In tab A click into the note body, replace the text with "agent9-VERSION-A" and wait ~3 s until it is saved (a GraphQL UpdateOneNote request goes out).
In tab B look at the record: the left Fields panel now shows Body = "agent9-VERSION-A" while the body editor on the right still shows the old text ("a").
In tab B replace the body with "agent9-VERSION-B-STALE" and wait ~3 s.
In tab A look at the record: the Fields panel now shows "agent9-VERSION-B-STALE" while its editor still shows "agent9-VERSION-A".

findings.actual: The panel's search field stays empty and the command list is not filtered. Reproduced twice: after \"z\" the body got \"z\", after \"q\" it became \"zq\".
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev / tim@apple.dev and open https://5500-ixmruf4hfnd9dnfal6vzl.e2b.app/object/note/79938dea-a992-42da-a591-3c0445575a54 (my own note "agent10-Note Export", body: two blocks "Export Note" and "second paragraph agent10 export body").

Look at the panel's search field and at the note body in the middle of the page.

findings.name: Text typed into the Body field popover is silently lost when the Note tab editor is used next

The Note tab editor kept the stale content it had loaded before the popover edit and its save overwrote the whole body, so the earlier edit is lost without any warning. (on /object/note/b57c3afe-cfb3-4e46-84a1-3db25c7e366f)
findings.expected: The note body keeps both edits: the paragraph \"POPOVER8\" added through the Body field and the \"NOTEEDIT\" text added in the Note tab editor, because both editors write the same Body field.
findings.actual: After the reload the body contains \"...bold BB then italic II end NOTEEDIT\" only — the \"POPOVER8\" paragraph typed in the Body field popover is gone. The Note tab editor kept the stale content it had loaded before the popover edit and its save overwrote the whole body, so the earlier edit is lost without any warning.
reproSteps: Open the note record page /object/note/b57c3afe-cfb3-4e46-84a1-3db25c7e366f (note "agent8-NoteA", created by me) on the Note tab.
In the Fields panel on the left, click the Body field value ("agent8 first line") so the rich-text popover editor opens.

At the end of the last block in that popover type a new paragraph " POPOVER8" and press Escape (the popover closes; the change is saved — this same Escape-saves behaviour was confirmed earlier with "ESC_ADDED").
Without reloading, click at the end of the last line in the Note tab editor on the right and type " NOTEEDIT".
Reload the page and read the note body.

reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open the note record /object/note/14611a41-c44e-4294-9ac5-0acdaff3ffa8 ("agent9-note-UNSAVED").

findings.expected: The Timeline shows an activity for the task being completed (e.g. \"You completed a related task agent6-task-alpha\" with its date), so the record's history agrees with the Tasks tab where the task is now in DONE.
findings.actual: The Timeline only shows \"You created a related task agent6-task-alpha\" — no entry at all for the completion, not even after a full page reload. The record's Timeline still reads as if the task were never completed. Done twice (completed, re-opened to TODO, completed again): no entry either time.
reproSteps: Open the company record /object/company/586586e5-ecfe-47c9-83f5-ef0d3717043d (company "agent6-co-beta").

Open the Tasks tab and click the round checkbox on the left of the task card "agent6-task-alpha" (created earlier from this tab): the card moves from TODO 1 to DONE 1 and the counter reads "Tasks 1 / DONE 1".

Read the Timeline entries.

findings.name: Timeline field changes hide the old value and keep the first edit's timestamp
findings.summary: The same single entry stays \"You updated 3 fields on agent6-co-beta — 9 minutes ago\" and merely rewrites its own line to \"Account Owner → Phil Schiler\". It never records that the owner had been \"Jony Ive\" (or that it was set to Jony Ive a few minutes before), and the entry's timestamp remains the one from the first edit 9 minutes earlier even though the owner was changed seconds ago. (on /object/company/586586e5-ecfe-47c9-83f5-ef0d3717043d)
findings.expected: Each field change is a timeline entry that shows what the field was and what it became (old → new) and the time of that change, so the record's history shows the Account Owner went from Jony Ive to Phil Schiler just now.
findings.actual: The same single entry stays \"You updated 3 fields on agent6-co-beta — 9 minutes ago\" and merely rewrites its own line to \"Account Owner → Phil Schiler\". It never records that the owner had been \"Jony Ive\" (or that it was set to Jony Ive a few minutes before), and the entry's timestamp remains the one from the first edit 9 minutes earlier even though the owner was changed seconds ago.
reproSteps: Open the company record /object/company/586586e5-ecfe-47c9-83f5-ef0d3717043d ("agent6-co-beta") on the Timeline tab.

In the Fields panel, set Account Owner to "Jony Ive" (click the Account Owner value, type Jony, pick "Jony Ive"); the Timeline shows "You updated ... Account Owner → Jony Ive" (here it first even showed "Account Owner → Empty").
A few minutes later set Account Owner to "Phil Schiler" the same way, then reload the page.
Read the Timeline: the same aggregated entry now says "You updated 3 fields on agent6-co-beta — 9 minutes ago" with the line "Account Owner → Phil Schiler" and no earlier value anywhere.

findings.name: An invalid record address shows an empty ghost record plus raw `Invalid value for UUID` error toasts
findings.summary: The app renders an empty ghost record page: the header shows \"Companies / Untitled (0/0)\", a skeleton avatar and title, an empty Fields panel with grey placeholders (Domain Name, Account Owner, Annual Revenue, Address, LinkedIn, Creation date, Created by), the full tab set (Timeline/Tasks/Notes/Files/Emails/Calendar), \"Send Email\" in the top bar and \"No activity yet\" — as if a real record existed. Over the bottom-right corner it stacks raw error toasts reading `Invalid value for UUID: \"does-not-exist\"` (three of them, one per failed request). There is no \"record not found\" message and no way back. (on /object/company/does-not-exist)
findings.expected: The page says the record was not found (or is invalid) with a way back to the Companies list, and does not show an editable empty record with raw `Invalid value for UUID: "does-not-exist"` error toasts.

Over the bottom-right corner it stacks raw error toasts reading `Invalid value for UUID: \"does-not-exist\"` (three of them, one per failed request). There is no \"record not found\" message and no way back.

findings.name: Notes tab still counts 1 note after the only note is deleted ("No notes" shown)
findings.summary: The tab header count stays \"Notes 1\" while the panel already shows the empty state \"No notes — There are no associated notes with this record.\" The stale 1 remains until the page is reloaded, when it reads \"Notes 0\". Happened both times a note was deleted from the record (with a titled note "agent6-note-alpha" and with a fresh empty note). (on /object/company/586586e5-ecfe-47c9-83f5-ef0d3717043d)
findings.expected: After deleting the only note, the Notes tab header and the panel agree: the count shows 0 (or no count) together with the \"No notes\" state.
findings.actual: The tab header count stays \"Notes 1\" while the panel already shows the empty state \"No notes — There are no associated notes with this record.\" The stale 1 remains until the page is reloaded, when it reads \"Notes 0\". Happened both times a note was deleted from the record (with a titled note "agent6-note-alpha" and with a fresh empty note).
reproSteps: Open the company record /object/company/586586e5-ecfe-47c9-83f5-ef0d3717043d ("agent6-co-beta"), Notes tab.
Create a note with "+ New note" (title "agent6-note-alpha" or leave it Untitled).
Open the note card, click "Options" at the bottom right of the note panel, then "Delete Note".
Read the Notes tab header and the panel: header says "Notes 1", panel says "No notes".
